officialInventory.summary: The Institut Congolais pour la Conservation de la Nature (ICCN) manages nearly all protected areas (Luki and Yangambi are exceptions). It publishes counts but no list: its website (2026) states 8 national parks, 63 hunting domains and reserves, 4 botanical and 4 zoological gardens. It names the 8 parks, the Okapi faunal reserve, Lomako-Yokokala, Tumba-Lediima, the Couloir Vert, and in a 2026 news item Bili-Uere, Itombwe and Abumonbazi. Older government reports give 7 national parks and 57 or 63 reserves and hunting domains, plus 3 biosphere reserves and 117 forest reserves (NR4 2009, ICCN strategy 2012, NBSAP 2016). The 6th national report (2019) has a list, but it is copied from WDPA and was not used. This inventory comes from creation and delimitation acts on FAOLEX (many from the Journal Officiel) and UNESCO pages. An IUCN/PACO 2010 assessment of 19 sites (labelled NGO) fills gaps. Most of the 57-63 hunting domains and reserves are not enumerated.

areas.name: Parc National des Virunga

legalStatus.text: Created 21 April 1925 as Parc National Albert (royal decree, per IUCN/PACO 2010); boundaries per a 1954 ordinance (UNESCO). Creating act not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 784,368 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010; UNESCO property 800,000 ha. Also a World Heritage site (inscribed 1979; in danger since 1994) and a Ramsar site (6th national report).

areas.name: Parc National de la Garamba

legalStatus.text: Royal decree of 17 March 1938 (per IUCN/PACO 2010; UNESCO: 'established by royal decree in 1938'). Creating act not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 4,900 km² per IUCN/PACO 2010 (UNESCO property 512,736 ha). Surrounded by three hunting domains, which IUCN/PACO does not name. World Heritage site (inscribed 1980; in danger since 1996).

areas.name: Parc National de Kahuzi-Biega

legalStatus.text: Created by Ordonnance 70-316 du 30 novembre 1970; limits fixed by Ordonnance 75-238 du 22 juillet 1975 (which abrogates 70-316)

areas.notes: Area 600,000 ha after the 1975 extension (IUCN/PACO 2010; UNESCO property 600,000 ha). Preceded by a 1937 integral reserve (IUCN/PACO). World Heritage site (inscribed 1980; in danger since 1997).

areas.name: Parc National de la Salonga

legalStatus.text: Ordonnance(-loi) 70-318 du 30 novembre 1970 (per UNESCO and IUCN/PACO 2010). Text not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 3,600,000 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010 and the UNESCO property; the UNESCO integrity statement gives 3,334,600 ha. Two blocks (North and South). World Heritage site (inscribed 1984; on the danger list 1999-2021).

areas.name: Parc National de l'Upemba

legalStatus.text: Created by décret du 15 mai 1939; limits fixed by Ordonnance 75-241 du 22 juillet 1975 (réserve naturelle intégrale + zone annexe)

areas.notes: Area 1,773,000 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010, which also describes a 10,000 km² integral reserve plus a zone annexe of about 3,000 km², so the figures are inconsistent. ICCN lists the Upemba lakes complex as a Ramsar site.

areas.name: Parc National de Kundelungu

legalStatus.text: Created by Ordonnance 70-317 du 30 novembre 1970; delimitation and regime by Ordonnance 75-097 du 1er mars 1975 (which abrogates 70-317)

areas.notes: Area 760,000 ha (220,000 ha integral reserve + 540,000 ha zone annexe) per IUCN/PACO 2010. Park staff also manage the Tshangalele partial reserve.

areas.name: Parc National de la Maiko

legalStatus.text: Ordonnance(-loi) n°70-312 du 20 novembre 1970 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Text not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 1,083,000 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010; spans the former Province Orientale, Maniema and Nord-Kivu.

areas.name: Parc National de la Lomami

legalStatus.text: Created by a decree of July 2016 (per the DRC's UNESCO tentative-list submission). Decree number and text not found.

areas.notes: Area 887,900 ha per the 6th national report; the tentative-list entry gives an 8,874 km² block plus a 22,000 km² buffer zone set by the same decree. ICCN calls it the newest national park.

areas.name: Parc Marin des Mangroves
areas.designationLabel: Réserve naturelle des Mangroves ou Parc marin

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel 044/CM/ECN/92 du 2 mai 1992 (zone A integral protection, zone B partial protection, 2 km coastal marine strip)

areas.notes: In Moanda, Kongo Central. The arrêté gives no area; 768 km² (20% in the Atlantic) is from IUCN/PACO 2010. The 6th national report calls it 'Parc national des mangroves', but ICCN's 2026 count of 8 national parks excludes it. A Ramsar site (ICCN; 6th national report).

areas.name: Réserve de Faune à Okapis
areas.designationLabel: Réserve naturelle dénommée « Réserve de faune à okapis »

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel 045/CM/ECN/92 du 2 mai 1992

areas.notes: Area 1,372,625 ha per the arrêté. In the Mambasa, Wamba and Watsa zones (Haut-Zaïre region, per the arrêté). World Heritage site (inscribed 1996; in danger since 1997).

areas.name: Réserve de Faune de Lomako-Yokokala
areas.designationLabel: Réserve naturelle dénommée Réserve de Faune

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°024/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 28 juin 2006

areas.notes: Territoires of Befale and Bongandanga (former Equateur). Area 3,625 km² per the arrêté. Bonobo site.

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle d'Itombwe

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°038/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 11 octobre 2006

areas.notes: South Kivu (Mwenga, Fizi, Uvira, Walungu). The arrêté gives no area; 760,000 ha is from IUCN/PACO 2010. The 6th national report still lists the Itombwe mountains as an unprotected IBA/AZE, which conflicts with the 2006 arrêté.

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle de Tumba-Lediima

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°053/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 07 décembre 2006

areas.notes: Bikoro, Lokolela and Inongo territories. Area 7,500 km² per the arrêté. Lies within the Ngiri-Tumba-Maindombe Ramsar site (named in the 6th national report).

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle du Sankuru

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°045/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/03/PDB/07 du 06 novembre 2007

areas.notes: Katako-Kombe and Lomela territories (Sankuru). Area 30,570 km² per the arrêté. Community-based management under contract with ICCN (2015 strategy).

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle du Triangle de la Ngiri

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°001/CAB/MIN/ECN-T/27/JEB/10 du 8 janvier 2011

areas.notes: Bomongo and Makanza territories. Area 5,500 km² per the arrêté. ICCN names 'la zone humide de Ngiri' as a Ramsar site (part of Ngiri-Tumba-Maindombe). No Wikidata item found.

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle de Tayna

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°012/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 03 avril 2006 (revising the 2002 'Réserve des Gorilles de Tayna' agrément)

areas.notes: Lubero and Walikale territories, North Kivu. No area in the arrêté. Community-managed under contract with ICCN. The Wikidata item is labelled 'Réserve des gorilles de Tayna' (the predecessor name).

areas.name: Réserve des Primates de Kisimba-Ikobo

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°013/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 03 avril 2006

areas.notes: Walikale territory, North Kivu. No area in the arrêté. Community-managed under contract with ICCN (RECOPRIBA).

areas.name: Réserve Naturelle de Kokolopori
areas.notes: Named by ICCN's 2015 strategy as a community-based nature reserve under contract with ICCN. No creating act was found. The 6th national report (2019) instead lists the 'Forêts de Kokolopori' as an unprotected AZE site, so the sources conflict.

areas.name: Réserve Communautaire des Bonobos d'Iyondji
areas.notes: 6th national report: governance shared between ICCN and local communities, with AWF and Forests of Bonobos. It also calls the reserve a 'forêt classifiée' managed collaboratively. No creating act found; the year and area appear only in the WDPA-derived annex, which was not used.

areas.name: Réserve Scientifique de la Luo
areas.notes: 6th national report: managed by the Centre de recherche en sciences naturelles (CRSN/Mabali), private-type governance. No creating act found.

areas.name: Réserve intégrale du Mont Hoyo
areas.notes: About 125 km north of Beni (Ituri). Area 6,000 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010; no creating act found. The NBSAP and 6th national report list Mont Hoyo as an IBA under 0% protection, which conflicts with this. No Wikidata item for the reserve.

areas.name: Réserve naturelle intégrale de la Nsele

legalStatus.text: Ordonnance n°83-110 du 5 mai 1983 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Text not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 3,550 ha, about 60 km east of Kinshasa, next to the Nsele presidential domain (IUCN/PACO 2010). Current status unverified. The Wikidata items 'Domaine de la Nsele' and 'parc de la vallée de la N'sele' were not matched.

areas.name: Réserve partielle de Tshangalele

legalStatus.text: Arrêté n°52/72 du 28/07/1955 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Text not fetched.

areas.notes: Bird reserve managed by Kundelungu National Park staff (IUCN/PACO 2010). Area not documented.

areas.name: Réserve d'Abumonbazi
areas.notes: Named by ICCN (2026) among 13 priority protected areas. Type, creating act and area not found. Also spelled Abumombazi.

areas.name: Réserve de Luki
areas.notes: The 6th national report says Luki is one of the reserves not managed by ICCN. The NBSAP calls it 'Reserve forestière de Luki' and 'réserve de la Biosphère de la Luki' (Mayumbe). Also a UNESCO biosphere reserve. No national creating act found; area not given in narrative text.

areas.name: Réserve de Yangambi
areas.notes: The 6th national report names the 'Reserve de Yangambi' as a protected area not managed by ICCN. Also a UNESCO biosphere reserve. National legal status and area not documented in the fetched sources.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse de Bili-Uere

legalStatus.text: Arrêté ministériel n°00023 du 12/03/1974 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Text not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 6,000,000 ha in seven blocks, blocks 1 and 2 being integral reserves (IUCN/PACO 2010). On the borders with Sudan and the Central African Republic.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse et réserve à hippopotames de Mangai

legalStatus.text: Arrêtés n°205/Agri du 14 juin 1940 and 414/Agri du 3 juillet 1944; transferred to ICCN by arrêté départemental n°036/DECNT/BCE/78 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Texts not fetched.

areas.notes: Area 1,176,875 ha (IUCN/PACO 2010): Idiofa hunting domain plus Mangai hippopotamus reserve. The 6th national report calls it 'Reserve naturelle de Mangai'.

areas.name: Domaine et réserve de chasse de Bombo-Lumene

legalStatus.text: Domain created 1968, reserve within it 1976 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Acts not identified.

areas.notes: About 120 km from Kinshasa, Batéké plateau. Approximate area 350,000 ha (IUCN/PACO 2010).

areas.name: Domaine de chasse et réserve de Bushimaie

legalStatus.text: Four blocks created by successive arrêtés in 1939, 1947 and 1959 (per IUCN/PACO 2010). Acts not identified.

areas.notes: Luiza, Dibaya and Luilu territories (Kasaï). Area 487,000 ha (IUCN/PACO 2010). Wikidata has a duplicate item, Q5001514.

areas.name: Domaine de Chasse de Basse Kando

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°055/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 07 décembre 2006, revising Arrêté 52/48 du 27 mars 1957 (réserve totale de chasse)

areas.notes: Kolwezi and Lubudi territories. Area 17,500 ha per IUCN/PACO 2010; the arrêté gives none. The original reserve dates from 1957.

areas.name: Domaine de Chasse de Kiziba-Baluba

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°054/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 07 décembre 2006, revising Arrêté 52/47 du 06 mai 1954 (réserve intégrale de chasse, Kipushi)

areas.notes: Kipushi territory. No area in the arrêté.

areas.name: Domaine et Réserve de Chasse de Swa-Kibula

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté ministériel n°056/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 08 décembre 2006 (recites 1951 arrêtés incl. n°656/AGRI du 24 décembre 1951, Swa-Chutes)

areas.notes: Kasongo-Lunda territory, Kwango. No area in the arrêté.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse d'Oshwe

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté n°036/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2004 du 7 juin 2004; article 5 revised by Arrêté ministériel n°057/CAB/MIN/ECN-EF/2006 du 08 décembre 2006

areas.notes: Oshwe territory (Bandundu province at the time of the act). Customary hunting rights kept. No area given.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse de Rutshuru

legalStatus.text: Created by Arrêté n°00024 du 14 février 1974

areas.notes: Rutshuru zone, North Kivu, bounded east by the national border. Area not given. Current status not verified.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse de Luama-Katanga
areas.designationLabel: Domaine de chasse (also called 'réserve naturelle de la Luama Katanga' in the act)

legalStatus.text: Arrêté n°52/36 du 15 avril 1954 (creation, abrogated); limits redefined and 5,967.81 ha partly déclassé by Arrêté ministériel n°002/CAB/MIN/ECN-T/03/JEB/11 du 19 janvier 2011

areas.notes: Area 343,500 ha per the 2011 arrêté, which says an equal area is to be added elsewhere. The 1954 creating arrêté placed it in Katanga province.

areas.name: Domaine de chasse de Lubudi-Sampwe
areas.notes: Mentioned by IUCN/PACO 2010 as a hunting domain forming an ecological corridor with Upemba and Kundelungu. Also listed as a conservation-priority site in the 4th national report. Creating act and area not found.

areas.name: Couloir Vert Kivu-Kinshasa
areas.designationLabel: Aire protégée à vocation de réserve communautaire

legalStatus.text: Created by Décret n°25/01 du 15 janvier 2025 under Loi 14/003 as amended by Loi 24/020 of 30 Dec 2024

areas.notes: Area 544,270 km² per the decree; it aims to protect over 100,000 km² of primary forest. It covers the RN4 (Beni-Kisangani), the Congo River (Kisangani-Kinshasa) and territories north and south of this corridor; the decree text read does not say how it relates to existing protected areas. The decree keeps pre-existing community rights until zoning. Management may be delegated by PPP. ICCN's page also cites Décret n°24/22 of 11 Dec 2024 creating the project. No Wikidata item found.

areas.name: Réserve de Faune de Kabobo
areas.designationLabel: Réserve de faune (provisional protection pending a definitive act)

legalStatus.text: Provisional protection measures by provincial Arrêté n°10/060/CAB.GOUV/TANG/NKR/2016 du 21 décembre 2016, 'en attendant la signature par le Premier ministre d'un acte définitif'

areas.notes: Kalemie territory (Tumbwe chiefdom). The provincial act gives about 1,500 km². The 6th national report says a 'Reserve naturelle de Kabobo (147700 ha)' was classified between 2014 and 2018, citing an NGO. No definitive classification act was found.

areas.name: Réserve de Ngandja
areas.notes: 6th national report: 'la réserve de Ngandja, créée en juin 2016 (317000 ha)', citing a Rainforest Trust web page. No creating act found; status unverified.

notEnumerated.category: hunting domains and reserves (domaines et réserves de chasse) not listed above
notEnumerated.reason: ICCN states 63 'domaines de chasse et réserves' (57 in the 2012 strategy and NBSAP 2016) but publishes no list. The only list found (6th national report annex) is copied from WDPA. Recorded here: hunting domains and reserves whose act was fetched or that ICCN or IUCN/PACO name. Gangala-na-Bodio, Maika-Penge, Rubi-Tele, Bomu, Luama-Kivu and others appear only in WDPA-derived tables or priority lists and are not recorded.
Counted in the NBSAP 2016 and NR4 (2009), which say many colonial-era forest reserves exist only on paper. No official list found.

ICCN names them, but they are ex situ facilities, not in-situ protected areas: Jardins botaniques de Kinshasa, Kisantu, Eala and Gbadolite; Jardins zoologiques de Kinshasa, Lubumbashi, Kisangani and Gbadolite.

notEnumerated.category: local community forest concessions (concessions forestières des communautés locales) and other community-conserved areas
notEnumerated.reason: The 6th national report and the 2015 ICCN strategy mention community forests and community-conserved areas, but give no list of those with protected-area status.

gaps: No official list of the DRC protected-area network was found. ICCN's site gives only counts and a few names, and the CBD 6th national report's lists (Tableau 2/19 and Annexe 1 to Objectif 5) are taken from Protected Planet/WDPA and were deliberately not used.

Counts disagree across sources and dates. National parks: 7 in 2009-2016, 8 since Lomami (2016) per ICCN. The Parc Marin des Mangroves is counted as a park by the 6th national report but not by ICCN. Reserves and hunting domains: 57 (2012 strategy, NBSAP 2016) or 63 (NR4 2009, ICCN 2026).

The founding acts of Virunga (1925), Garamba (1938), Salonga (Ord. 70-318), Maiko (Ord. 70-312), Lomami (decree of July 2016), Bili-Uere, Mangai, Bombo-Lumene, Bushimaie, Nsele and Tshangalele were not fetched. Their legal bases rest on UNESCO pages, the DRC's tentative-list entry and the IUCN/PACO 2010 report (NGO).

Kahuzi-Biega, Kundelungu and Upemba legal bases come from the 1975 delimitation ordinances, which cite the original 1970 ordinances and the 1939 decree. Park areas come mostly from IUCN/PACO 2010 or UNESCO; later boundary changes are not reflected.

Kokolopori, Iyondji, Luo, Abumonbazi, Luki, Yangambi, Mont Hoyo, Lubudi-Sampwe and Ngandja are recorded from mentions in official reports, ICCN or IUCN/PACO without a creating act. Kokolopori and Mont Hoyo are described elsewhere in the 6th national report as unprotected.

Kabobo is recorded as 'proposed'. The 2016 provincial arrêté gives only provisional protection pending a Prime Minister's act. The 6th national report claims a 147,700 ha 'Reserve naturelle de Kabobo' was classified, but no act was found.

The Bassin de la Lufira, which the 6th national report says was added to the protected-area network in 2017 (4,470,993 ha), appears to be the Ramsar designation. No national creating act was found, so it is left to the coordinator's Ramsar handling. The Ngiri-Tumba-Maindombe Ramsar site overlaps the Ngiri and Tumba-Lediima reserves.

The Couloir Vert Kivu-Kinshasa (2025, 544,270 km²) covers a quarter of the country. Its relationship to existing protected areas inside its perimeter is not stated in the decree text read, and its zoning was still to follow a public inquiry.

A 2008 arrêté creating 'sanctuaires' was annulled in 2009 (Arrêté 094/2009), so no sanctuaries are recorded. The Arrêté départemental of 1977 protecting the 'parc de la Révolution' concerns the Kinshasa botanical garden (ex situ) and is not recorded.
The ICCN pages fetched (2026) give no creation dates or areas. Coordinates were left null: legal texts give boundary descriptions or ranges, not point coordinates.

Wikidata QIDs were checked with wbsearchentities/wbgetentities (P17 = DR Congo, P31 park/reserve/protected area). No QID was assigned where no matching protected-area item was found: Ngiri, Basse Kando, Kiziba-Baluba, Swa-Kibula, Oshwe, Rutshuru, Luama-Katanga, Lubudi-Sampwe, Mont Hoyo reserve, Nsele, Tshangalele, Abumonbazi, Kabobo, Ngandja and Couloir Vert. The Luki and Yangambi QIDs are the biosphere-reserve items.
